🚆 7 YEARS · GTFS DATA · PYTHON
Python GTFS Power BI Open Data Data Storytelling

Did Free Transit Actually Grow Luxembourg's Network?

Analysed 7 years of official GTFS schedule data (2018–2025) from Luxembourg's Open Data Portal to measure the real impact of making public transport free in 2020. Key finding: departures more than doubled (23,549 → 50,691), routes grew by 246, and weekend service expanded ×7.8 , far outpacing 15% population growth.

The person behind the data

About me

Hi, I'm Khadija Mustafa, a Civil Engineer who found her true calling in data. What started as tracking sales metrics at a Luxembourg e-commerce company turned into a full career pivot into data analytics and AI.

My engineering background gives me a problem-solving mindset that I now apply to data: breaking down complexity, finding what matters, and communicating it clearly. I'm a member of Girls in Tech Luxembourg and currently enrolled full-time in the AI Academy at Digital Learning Hub Luxembourg, following the Holberton School curriculum in machine learning engineering.

I'm passionate about turning raw, messy data into clear decisions: Power BI dashboards for marketing teams, for a marketing team machine learning pipelines for predictive insights, and AI agents built with open-source models.
